get.description: Accept exactly one code and one state. Ignore unrecognized OAuth response parameters and reject provider error responses. Consume state once and exchange code using PKCE. Verify issuer/audience/signature/nonce; rotate the opaque session, set a Secure HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie and redirect to a validated same-origin path. For browser navigations accepting HTML, redirect a refused callback to the welcome page with a safe problem code and trace ID so the user can restart sign-in. API clients receive the original problem response. Never log code/state/tokens.

get.description: Apply the shared ownership, input, idempotency and version rules in the contract decisions. Agent credentials may read only the original part/stage/item/content_version cited by project-scoped work visible to that credential; absent or uncited targets return 404. Owner sessions may read their own artifacts. Return provenance and stable keys from that exact version. Agents must supply the cited version query; an omitted version is invalid input rather than an implicit read of latest content. Historical selection uses publication_id plus part/stage and optional content digest; identical content may have different provenance. Agents must supply both the work publication_id and cited version, otherwise 400.

post.description: Verify configured GitHub repository/default branch and ancestry through a read-only repository connection; never fetch a caller-supplied network host. Missing authorization or unverifiable ancestry fails closed. First publication requires matching consent; 20 MiB body, 1000 files and 10000 parsed items are aggregate limits. Existing legacy hub endpoints remain separately unchanged. SHA-256 lowercase hexadecimal of UTF-8 RFC 8785 canonical JSON for {"format":"nexus.preview/1","project_id":projectId,"snapshot":S}. Preserve array order and every remaining field/value, including commit, base_commit, raw source strings, paths, media types and file digests. Do not normalize Unicode, newlines or source content. This pre-consent envelope contains no session, bearer credential, idempotency key, consent ID or server timestamp. The publisher shows its preview and digest before consent, then sends the same S plus the issued consent_id. The owner sends this digest to API-227; the server recomputes it from the received API-225 body, project ID and this versioned algorithm before accepting the first publication. A changed field, array order, source or commit requires fresh consent. A project-scoped owner consent is single-use, bound to the digest and consumed atomically with the first durable publication; an idempotent retry returns its original receipt. Existing projects send consent_id:null and do not bypass ownership, source verification or ancestry checks.
